results.title: Jordan's national team continues preparations for the 2026 World Cup and is gearing up to face Austria - Roya News
highlights:
Jordan's national team continues preparations for the 2026 World Cup and is gearing up to face Austria - Roya News

#### The national football team, “Al-Nashama”, continues its preparations for its first match in the 2026 World Cup against Austria.

The team will enter its training camp in the American city of Portland, where it will be based during the tournament, and will continue its training there until the match scheduled for Wednesday, June 17.

The national team concluded its training camp in San Diego, USA, as part of the final preparation program before the start of the World Cup, following the friendly match that brought it together with Colombia.

The training session of the Jordanian national team in San Diego was attended by His Royal Highness Crown Prince Al Hussein bin Abdullah II, who, during his conversation with the players, praised the level of tactical discipline and its role in enhancing the team’s readiness to compete at the global level.

The Crown Prince stressed the importance of adhering to the instructions of the technical staff, led by the coach, and the necessity of high focus and mental preparation given the magnitude of the responsibility placed on the players, noting that all Jordanians stand behind the national team in its upcoming commitments, while emphasizing the importance of delivering a respectable performance regardless of the result.

All the players are in good health, including Awda Al-Fakhoury, who has recovered from the injury he sustained during the Colombia match and participated in training normally.

Player Mohammad Abu Ghosh was called up in place of Ibrahim Sabra, after medical examinations showed that Sabra had suffered a tear in the ligaments of his left ankle, which necessitated his exclusion from the list.

Player Mohammad Abu Ghosh is one of the attacking options for national team coach Jamal Salami, after Sabra's absence from the current squad due to injury.

results.title: Jordan plays Columbia; injury list grows ahead of  World Cup | Jordan Times
highlights:
AMMAN — As Jordan prepares to play Columbia on Sunday in their final tune-up match ahead of World Cup kicking off June 11, Jordan’s squad got another setback with news that key young striker Ibrahim Sabra, had joined players sidelined with injury.
[...]
The ankle injury during practice added to the woes of the coaching staff who were already challenged with options as key players sitting out the lineup include star striker Yazan Nue’imat and Adham Qurashi, who have been out the past few months. Before the lineup was finalised, Isam Smeiri, who had excelled in the Arab Cup in Nue’imat’s absence was injured during practice. Now Sabra, one of the key stars of Jordan’s U23 team, who plays for Croatia’s NK Lokomotiva Zaghreb, is out for the World Cup as well.
[...]
The match against 7-time World Cup qualifier, 13th ranked Columbia which will be played in San Diego at 4:00 pm Pacific time Sunday (2:00 am Jordan local time on Monday), will be the final friendly before the World’s biggest sporting event - the 2026 World Cup starts in the US, Canada and Mexico.
[...]
Earlier in the week, World 63rd ranked Jordan lost to 12-time qualifier World 19th ranked Switzerland 4-1 in a match that saw clear defensive errors and Jordan’s young star Odeh Fakhoury scoring the sole goal. Now, the team will seek to amend mistakes before heading to Portland where the squad will be based for their first two World Cup matches.
[...]
The team is the focus of a whole nation. In an interview with CNN, Jordan Football Association President HRH Prince Ali told Becky Anderson, “The players will give it all they have. We have had some injuries including the best striker in Asia, Yazan Nu’eimat, but the team has a lot of potential. He described the Kingdom’s qualification as hugely inspiring for the young generation, describing Jordan as “the representative of the Levant.”

results.title: National Football Team Concludes World Cup Preparations After Colombia Friendly - The Jordan News Agency
highlights:
Amman, June 8 (Petra) – The national football team concluded its final phase of preparations for the 2026 FIFA World Cup following a 2–0 defeat to Colombia in a friendly match held on Monday at Snapdragon Stadium in San Diego.
[...]
The match served as the team’s last test ahead of its historic first appearance at the World Cup finals, with the technical staff using the encounter to assess overall readiness and fine-tune tactical and physical aspects before the start of the tournament.
[...]
The coaching staff, led by Jamal Sellami, rotated the squad extensively throughout the match, giving opportunities to a wide range of players across all positions in an effort to evaluate depth and balance within the team.
[...]
The national side entered the fixture with a structured lineup featuring Yazeed Abu Laila in goal, a defensive unit composed of Ehsan Haddad, Abdullah Nasib, Yazan Al-Arab and Saleem Obeid, and a midfield anchored by Muhannad Abu Taha, Nizar Al-Rashdan and Noor Al-Rawabdeh. The attacking line included Mousa Al-Tamari, Ouda Al-Fakhouri and Ali Olwan.
[...]
Throughout the match, the coaching staff made several tactical substitutions across both halves in an effort to rotate the squad and give playing time to a wide range of players, including changes in all departments of the team.
[...]
The friendly marked the end of the team’s pre-World Cup camp, which included a series of training sessions and international friendlies aimed at building cohesion and improving match fitness ahead of the global tournament.

highlights:

[...]
# Ibrahim Sabra out, Mohammad Taha completes Jordan’s 2026 World Cup squad | OneFootball
[...]
## Ibrahim Sabra out, Mohammad Taha completes Jordan’s 2026 World Cup squad
[...]
Jordan have finalised Jamal Sellami’s squad, with 20-year-old Al-Hussein defender Mohammad Taha called up after forward Ibrahim Sabra withdrew with a left ankle ligament rupture sustained in training last week.
[...]
According to L'Équipe, the Moroccan coach has added Taha to his 26-player list for the World Cup.
[...]
Taha, who will wear number 18, was preferred to Al-Hussein team-mate Yousef Qashi due to his versatility, offering extra options down the left.
[...]
A member of the delegation suggested some players might unconsciously be preserving themselves before a first historic World Cup, with injuries already mounting. The squad will reach their base in Portland on Thursday.
[...]
Drawn in Group J with Argentina, Algeria and Austria, Jordan open against Austria on Wednesday 17 June at six am in Santa Clara.
